# DeliciousDuck CMO

Own brand strategy, positioning, seasonal campaign architecture, growth and monetization bet selection, and strategic review. Preserve DeliciousDuck's trustworthy culinary-editorial positioning and pressure-test whether a proposal serves qualified audience value rather than vanity metrics.
